original_test_intent: Validate the complete SMBIOS Type 45 firmware-component inventory, versions/identifiers/formats, release/support/image/state metadata and associated-component relationships against the approved recipe and across reboot.
original_method: Preserve logs, collect complete raw Type 45 and referenced SMBIOS components on the verified SUT, reconcile every firmware entry and associated handle to the owner manifest with format/unit semantics, perform one approved reboot, repeat and make no firmware change.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the exact firmware-component/handle manifest and approves reboot/recovery; automation performs only protected read-only inventory comparison.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, hardware/firmware recipe, BIOS/SMBIOS and dmidecode identity
Expected component names, manufacturers, versions, version formats, firmware IDs and ID formats
Expected release dates, lowest-supported versions, image sizes/units, characteristics and states
Expected associated-component count and handle-to-component topology
Optional/staged/inactive component and sensitive identifier policy
Approved reboot, workload window, boot deadline and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Do not flash, stage, activate, rollback or update firmware
Preserve dmesg, syslog, SEL and firmware context; no log clearing
Keep SMBIOS collection read-only and protect firmware identifiers
Fail closed on unresolved handles, ambiguous format/unit, malformed dates or cross-host inventory
Require reboot approval and stop on firmware identity/state drift or recovery failure
No automatic retry or inferred component equivalence
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact target, manifest, format semantics and reboot approval
Collect complete Type 45 and referenced component structures
Normalize versions/IDs/dates/sizes/state while retaining raw values
Resolve every associated handle and compare pre/post inventory
Make no firmware/BIOS mutation, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve firmware component manifest, formats/units and handle topology
Review missing/extra/version/state/handle/persistence deviations and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 45` is relevant, but `grep -A1` drops all required fields/handles, has no reboot comparison and uses insecure SSH.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely archive complete raw/decoded Type 45 and referenced structures before/after one approved reboot, parse all component fields and resolve associated handles without any firmware operation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All thirteen Type 45 field groups, reboot persistence, source script and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Normalize each firmware entry by stable component identity, preserve raw format-specific values, decode version/ID/date/size/state under owner rules, resolve associated handles and compare the complete set across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds manifest and relationship validation while rejecting filtered evidence, log clearing and firmware mutation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Firmware Inventory heading cannot reveal missing components, wrong version format, stale minimum version, bad image-size units, invalid state or unresolved associated handles.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS inventory does not prove a firmware image's authenticity or functional health; those require separate signed-image/update/functional coverage and cannot be inferred here.

project_override_considerations: Staged/inactive components, version aliases or optional handles must be tied to exact firmware recipe and state; no override may add a flash/update operation to this read-only case.
expected_evidence: Verified target/recipe/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode identity and approved Type 45 manifest
Complete pre/post raw records with normalized component/version/ID/date/size/characteristics/state
Approved reboot timeline and inventory persistence diff
Preserved logs, no firmware mutation, secure-access/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require Type 45 inventory correctness and persistence. DeepSeek is incomplete but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The firmware manifest/format semantics and reboot approval are normal package/user inputs; they gate execution but not static review.

review_improvement: Preserves all firmware inventory fields and adds stable component identity, format/unit semantics and associated-handle topology while prohibiting firmware operations.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware versions and IDs are format-tagged, so string equality alone can compare semantically different encodings or hide a bad format declaration. The associated-component list is also cardinality-sensitive: all handles must resolve to intended structures, with no duplicates or hidden extras. Full raw-plus-normalized evidence is required, and the safest test boundary is strictly read-only because flashing would change the inventory being evaluated.
